frozen_gate_logic_audit.interpretation: The frozen analyzer treats integer zero support violations as false inside all(completeness_safety.values()). The independent audit recomputes the intended condition as support_violations == 0 without modifying the frozen analyzer.

manual_compute_gate.rationale: Within each search family, the four estimators are compute-matched: candidate-token ratios to E0 span 0.9881–1.0107, candidate-forward ratios span 0.9956–1.0121, and summed invocation-time ratios span 0.9544–0.9996. The independent audit also reconstructs one successful GPU1 session totaling 108.586 reserved hours. This PASS supports only the fairness and credibility of within-family estimator comparisons; it does not override the failed stability or positive-transfer gates, does not equate the deliberately different search-family budgets, and does not establish a winning estimator.
